lead_headline: Villa Tourism Peaks in Kaş and Kalkan
lead_deck: Villa accommodation in the region reaches its highest levels for the new season.
lead_body: Villa tourism in the Kaş and Kalkan regions has continued its rise, reaching a peak.
Industry representatives expect accommodation demand to reach its highest level, particularly in July.
lead_byline: Kalkan Today Editor · Google News — Kalkan/Kaş
col1_body: The project along the Demre, Kaş and Kalkan line puts archaeological sites at risk.
col3_body: Villa occupancy in Kaş and Kalkan will hit a ceiling in July.
magazine_lead_headline: Zoning Plan Change Approved in Kalkan
magazine_lead_body: Objections to the zoning plan in Kalkan were rejected with the signature of President Erdoğan.
